responsibility: This Texinfo file is the library reference scaffold for GNU Modula-2, organizing and documenting the standard and GM2-specific module set exposed to users. It defines the manual structure and menus for the base libraries, PIM/Logitech-compatible libraries, coroutine support, and ISO libraries, then embeds the definition-module interfaces of many individual library modules so the generated manual describes their exported constants, types, and procedures; in effect it is the top-level catalog and API reference source for the GM2 runtime and support libraries rather than a compiler implementation file.
